name: Capturando el Momento
source:
After being involved in a accident and spending a week at the hospital, Kuro returns to high-school. Soon after classes, he goes to the photography club where he meets with his friend, Kana, the second and last member of the club. After a small chitchat, Kuro is asked to take part in the last photography contest that the club will participate...

Can Kuro help her win the contest... or will something else happen?

[Translated and edited from [url=https://mora1920.itch.io/capturando-el]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
遭遇事故并在医院住了一个星期后，黑回到了高中。下课后不久，他去了摄影俱乐部，在那里他会见了他的朋友卡纳，他是俱乐部的第二位也是最后一位成员。一番闲聊后，黑被邀请参加俱乐部将参加的最后一次摄影比赛……

Kuro能否帮助她赢得比赛……还是会发生其他事情？

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://mora1920.itch.io/capturando-el]Itch.io[/url]]
